title: Add representative workload runners and reporting pipeline v6
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds v6 representative workload runners, profiling baselines, and a new reporting pipeline with a standardized metrics schema. Includes CI validation for reproducibility and backfills historical data.
description: Motivation: our existing benchmark lab runners and the reporting pipeline v5 showed drift in metric naming and missed key latency histograms for representative workloads. This PR introduces v6 representative workload runners, a profiling baseline exporter, and a standardized reporting pipeline that normalizes metrics, attaches workload metadata, and supports incremental backfill. Changes include: new workload runner harnesses for long-tail latency measurement, a profiling baseline producer that records per-run kernel/tensor timings, ETL updates to the reporting pipeline schema, CI checks for workload reproducibility, and migration scripts to backfill the last 6 months of data. Checklist: [x] new runners implemented and unit-tested, [x] profiling baseline exporter added, [x] ETL schema migration and backfill script, [x] CI jobs for reproducibility and perf-regression checks, [x] docs and example workload configs. Testing: local integration with sample GPU instances, end-to-end run in the benchmark staging infra, and CI that runs a smoke workload and validates metric schema and histograms. Rollback: revert the schema migration, disable the new CI gating, and restore v5 ETL within the pipeline. Related: ENG-8421 (benchmarking roadmap), ENG-9150 (perf regression alerts). See related PRs pr-18123 and pr-15620 for previous pipeline revisions.
